Name: K-POP Idol Light Stick to weapon
Author: wee06813
Description:
[size=6][b]== Mod Info ==[/b][/size][left]﻿[/left]
[center][/center][left][img]https://imgur.com/ZVBCGuF.png[/img]

[b]﻿[/b][b]This Mod will add K-pop idol's cheering light sticks to your farm.

You can buy these at 1,500 gold each.
You can also buy these at [size=4]Marlon[/size]'s store.[/b]

[b][size=5]+Need+[/size]

[list]
[*][size=2] The last version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2] The last version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][size=2]

[/size][size=5]+Installation+[/size]
[/b]
[list=1]
[*][b][size=2] Make sure your required file is up to date. [/size][/b][b][size=2]If not, download the latest version and put it under the /Mod folder.[/size][/b]
[*][size=2][b]Unpack the uploaded file and put it in the /Mod folder.[/b][/size]

[/list][b]
[size=5]+Uninstallation+[/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]Remove everything added by this mod.[/size]
[/list]

[size=5]+Language+[/size]
[/b]
[b][size=2]Only English and Korean[/size]


[/b][b][size=5]+Issue+[/size]
[size=3]
↓Language Output Errors[/size]
[size=2]  -Eng/영 :
[list]
[*][b] Special symbols do not appear correctly (apostrophe  '  ,  asterisk  * : It turns into a symbol in the game.)[/b]
[/list][/size][/b][b][size=2][/size][/b][b][size=2]  -Han/한 :
[list]
[*]한글화 오류: 일부 한글 미출력 (뿅이봉/뿅봉 - 뽕) →  해당 기호 ( * ) 로 출력됨
[/list][/size][/b][/left]

[b]I accept another error, typo, wrong explanation. If you know these things, please let me know.
다른 문제나 오타, 설명 오류 등 모두 수용하니 발견 시 제보 부탁드립니다.[/b]
